  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED` registry entry sets `on_values: ["1", "yes", "on"]`, so the watch treats `0`/`no`/`off` as off, but the workflow consumers (`vars.GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED != 'false'`, e.g. .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1184) keep the stage on for every value except `false`.
  WHY: A value of `off`, `no` or `0` keeps exporting github.token, and `_value_class` (scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:79-81) returns "off", so the watch sends a false Telegram WARNING once the wait time passes. All four reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and rejected it: it says the runtime consumers (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1259-1265, scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:263-266) disable the stage for `false|0|no|off`, so marking those values off is correct. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna reply that no workflow passes the variable to the helper, which therefore sees the default `true`.
- scripts/stage_switches.json:623-627 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `REVIEW_RUN_READ_CACHE_ENABLED` entry has no `on_values`, but its consumer `_gh_pr_cache_enabled` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1365-1371) treats `1`/`yes`/`on` as on.
  WHY: A value of `yes` keeps the read-cache stage on, but the watch reports it as off and sends a false "stage switch left off" alert. The reviewer rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/stage_switches.json:420-424 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `NEEDS_HUMAN_HEAD_LATCH_AUTO_RELEASE_ENABLED` entry has no `on_values`, but its consumer `_is_truthy` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:31651-31656, used at :27844) accepts `1|true|yes|on` as on.
  WHY: A value of `yes`, which the consumer treats as on, produces a false "stage switch left off" alert at the next daily run. The reviewer rated it NIT, mapped here to low.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stage_switches.json:GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED entry (around lines 279-283) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `on_values: ["1", "yes", "on"]` makes `_value_class` in scripts/stage_switch_watch.py mark `0`/`no`/`off` as off. No workflow passes `GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED:` to the scripts, so the case at scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1259-1265 always sees the default `true`. Only the workflow expression `!= 'false'` turns the stage off (consumers: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1184, promote-main-to-stable.yml:150, workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:122/442, test-and-mark-stable.yml:1987).
  WHY: An owner who sets the variable to `off` gets a stage that keeps running and, after 24 hours, a wrong Telegram WARNING. The failure is an extra alert only, never a missed one. Suggested fix: correct the editor rationale and note the false positive, or accept it as residual.
- HARDENING: scripts/stage_switches.json GH_READ_TOKEN_ENABLED "stage" text. Add a clause saying only `false` turns the stage off in workflows, while 0/no/off are reported as off but keep the job token on (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
